solutions.title: BFS level size
solutions.strategy: Use queue length at the start of each level to collect one row at a time.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every node is removed from the queue once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The output stores all node values and the queue can hold a level of nodes.

solutions.title: DFS depth buckets
solutions.strategy: Append a new bucket when first reaching a depth, then fill it with preorder traversal.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The output stores all values and recursion can add height-sized stack usage.
